inspection_kind: Maker manual visual observation; no quality certification or reviewer score.

source_scope.new_original_concept: Oblique overhead still life: deep opened cup at upper right, shallow folded cup at lower left, removed translucent lid leaned at rear right.

views.method: Native imagegen result and tools.view_image(detail=high), full image shown. An earlier detail=original emission showed only a small region, so high full-file view was repeated.
views.observations: All seven copy lines visible; rim, folded ribs, lid contacts, interior and full ground inspected.

views.method: Pillow LANCZOS reduction from unchanged original, tools.view_image
views.observations: All seven copy items read. Name/open cup first, folded puck second, promise and descriptor then date, preorder and URL. No clipping or product/text overlap.

views.method: Pillow LANCZOS reduction from unchanged original, tools.view_image
views.observations: Name and two product states remain recognizable; date and URL recognizable. Korean details are small, with exact glyph checking dependent on larger views.

copy_check.evidence: Upper left, uppercase F O L N, no repeated instance.
copy_check.glyph_observation: Stable uppercase shapes, no clipped strokes.

copy_check.evidence: Upper left beneath FOLN, title-case name in one line, clear separation between words.
copy_check.glyph_observation: Lowercase l/d and uppercase C read clearly. Large right edge leaves a narrow but visible gap to open cup rim.

copy_check.evidence: One line below product scene, left aligned; comma visible after 고.
copy_check.glyph_observation: Native view resolves 가/볍/게/접/고 and 다시/펼/치/다 without missing syllables.

copy_check.evidence: Beneath Korean promise; space between 350 and mL, lowercase m uppercase L, middle dot, full material wording visible.
copy_check.glyph_observation: Mixed Latin/Korean baseline looks coherent; no added product label.

copy_check.evidence: Lower-left release group; all numerals, two periods and uppercase RELEASE present.
copy_check.glyph_observation: Regular numeric and capital stroke shapes.

copy_check.evidence: Native and 720 views visibly leave gaps on both sides of the dash; date digits and Korean words are preserved.
copy_check.glyph_observation: Dash is visually en-dash-like. A raster cannot establish Unicode identity or literal spacing; visual transcription conservatively retains the apparent extra spacing.
copy_check.uncertainty: Needs independent comparison of visual interval to requested unspaced en dash; not certified exact.

copy_check.evidence: Final lower-left line; lowercase URL, single period and slash visible.

mandatory_conditions.observed: Exactly one own independent native poster saved; coordinator manages requested total two. Actual 1122×1402 is portrait and near 4:5 but not mathematically exact.
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Manifest width/height; entire image is a single flat poster without panels.
mandatory_conditions.limitation: 1122*5=5610, 1402*4=5608; no crop, pad or rescale of original/final.

mandatory_conditions.observed: All seven supplied lines present, no extra displayed copy found. Six transcribe as required; preorder date separator has apparent additional space.
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Copy check entries and native/720 views.

mandatory_conditions.observed: Handleless dark green folding body, milky translucent white lids, actual-still-life lighting and ground contacts. Expanded cup shows an open interior; folded puck shows shallow accordion geometry.
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Expanded cup upper right approx x550–951,y138–623; folded cup lower left approx x108–621,y518–858; removed lid rear right approx x900–1087,y157–554.
mandatory_conditions.limitation: 350 mL is confirmed from supplied copy only, not measured from pixels. Perfectly regular rings and fine grain can retain a synthetic product-render impression.

mandatory_conditions.observed: No handle, real brand/logo, cup-surface letters, price, performance claim or certification observed. FOLN appears only as poster copy.
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Cup exterior and inside, both lids, entire pale ground manually inspected.

mandatory_conditions.observed: Title at upper left shares height with the open cup mouth; diagonal depth contrast leads to folded puck and Korean promise. Release/preorder/URL are grouped below promise with consistent left alignment.
mandatory_conditions.limitation: Photo and promise still divide into a large upper product zone and lower text zone; promise is adjacent to the folded state but does not actively follow its shallow geometry. Other final images were not viewed, so set diversity is not claimed.

material_and_structure_check.evidence: Broad muted highlights over front lip and ribs; darker inner bowl and consistent green folds. Distinct curved rims and plausible nested sidewalls.
material_and_structure_check.residual: Native view shows a fine regular grain/crosshatch on lit exterior front band. Some texture remains across several bands rather than clearly changing with curvature and local light.

material_and_structure_check.evidence: Milky center with diffuse green-gray show-through in folded lid; brighter thicker white perimeter and soft highlights. Removed lid rests against the cup at rear right.
material_and_structure_check.residual: Folded lid center also shows fine dense grain. Exact transmission and contact behind the opened cup are not fully inspectable; rear resting point is partly occluded.

material_and_structure_check.evidence: Light pale-gray seamless ground, diffuse shadow to lower right, darker core beneath product contacts, broad tonal falloff.
material_and_structure_check.residual: Fine grain is widespread on the pale ground and resembles the fine scale on lid and silicone. It does not fully resolve the per-surface microtexture requirement.

material_and_structure_check.evidence: No handle; expanded rim and repeated fold steps coherent; foreground puck appears larger due perspective; soft key highlights and shadows broadly consistent.
material_and_structure_check.residual: Open interior is very dark so the actual bottom is not distinctly defined. Accordion/body geometry is plausible but idealized. Removed lid support is partly hidden.

retained_defects_uncertainties: Native 1122×1402 is only near 4:5; exact ratio not achieved.
Apparent spaces on both sides of preorder date dash; exact spacing/codepoint cannot be certified from raster.
Fine repetitive grain remains on ground, lid center and lit silicone; surfaces differ in gloss and shape but microtexture distinctness remains uncertain.
The promise/descriptor and action group occupy a conventional lower block; planned typography-depth integration is only partially manifested.
Open interior floor and removed-lid support are partly obscured; no pixel-based capacity claim.
320 view is for overall hierarchy, not exact Korean glyph certification; no print readiness or maximum-resolution guarantee.
